speaker: god
text: The LORD was very angry with your fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So tell the people that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Return to Me, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.’ But they did not listen or pay attention to Me, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’
name: The LORD

speaker: zechariah
text: What are these, my lord?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: I will show you what they are.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: man-among-myrtles
text: They are the ones the LORD has sent to patrol the earth.
name: The man among the myrtles

speaker: riders
text: We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and tranquil.
name: The riders

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel
text: Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity.’
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there My house will be rebuilt, declares the LORD of Hosts, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.’
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: Proclaim further that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘My cities will again overflow with prosperity; the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: What are these?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: What are these coming to do?
name: Zechariah

speaker: god
text: These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.
name: The LORD

speaker: zechariah
text: Where are you going?
name: Zechariah

speaker: measuring-man
text: To measure Jerusalem,
name: The man with the measuring line

speaker: measuring-man
text: and to determine its width and length.
name: The man with the measuring line

speaker: angel
text: Run and tell that young man: ‘Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of men and livestock within it.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: god
text: Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will surely wave My hand over them, so that they will become plunder for their own servants. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and they will become My people. I will dwell among you, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?
name: The LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Take off his filthy clothes!
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: See, I have removed your iniquity, and I will clothe you with splendid robes.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: zechariah
text: Let them put a clean turban on his head.
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts; and I will give you a place among these who are standing here.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a sign. For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: See the stone I have set before Joshua; on that one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I will engrave on it an inscription, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.’
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel
text: What do you see?
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: I see a solid gold lampstand,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven spouts to the lamps.
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: There are also two olive trees beside it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on its left.
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: What are these, my lord?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: Do you not know what they are?
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: No, my lord,
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone accompanied by shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: What are the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes from which the golden oil pours?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: Do you not know what these are?
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: No, my lord,
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: These are the two anointed ones who are standing beside the Lord of all the earth.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: What do you see?
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: I see a flying scroll,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land, for according to one side of the scroll, every thief will be removed; and according to the other side, every perjurer will be removed.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: I will send it out, declares the LORD of Hosts, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by My name. It will remain inside his house and destroy it, down to its timbers and stones.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: Now lift up your eyes and see what is approaching.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: What is it?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: A measuring basket is going forth.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: This is their iniquity in all the land.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: This is Wickedness,
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: Where are they taking the basket?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: To build a house for it in the land of Shinar,
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: And when it is ready, the basket will be set there on its pedestal.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: zechariah
text: What are these, my lord?
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: These are the four spirits of heaven, going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: angel
text: The one with the black horses is going toward the land of the north, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south.
name: The angel who spoke with me

speaker: god
text: Go and patrol the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, those going to the land of the north have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take an offering from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon—and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you are to tell him that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD; He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule. And He will be a priest on His throne, and there will be peaceful counsel between the two.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
name: The LORD

speaker: bethel-delegation
text: Should I weep and fast in the fifth month, as I have done these many years?
name: The men of Bethel

speaker: god
text: Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They made their hearts like flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets. Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And just as I had called and they would not listen, so when they called I would not listen, says the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known, and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go. Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were present when the foundations were laid to rebuild the temple, the house of the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For before those days neither man nor beast received wages, nor was there safety from the enemy for anyone who came or went, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as I did in the past,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the seed will be prosperous, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. To the remnant of this people I will give all these things as an inheritance.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As you have been a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah. Therefore you are to love both truth and peace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Peoples will yet come—the residents of many cities—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and the residents of one city will go to another, saying: ‘Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem and to plead before the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue will tightly grasp the robe of a Jew, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea; all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Pasture the flock marked for slaughter,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: whose buyers slaughter them without remorse. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!’ Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will no longer have compassion on the people of the land, declares the LORD, but behold, I will cause each man to fall into the hands of his neighbor and his king, who will devastate the land, and I will not deliver it from their hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: zechariah
text: I will no longer shepherd you. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish; and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh.
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: If it seems right to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them.
name: Zechariah

speaker: god
text: Throw it to the potter
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take up once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will neither care for the lost, nor seek the young, nor heal the broken, nor sustain the healthy, but he will devour the flesh of the choice sheep and tear off their hooves.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May a sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered and his right eye utterly blinded!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. Judah will be besieged, as well as Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day, declares the LORD, I will strike every horse with panic, and every rider with madness. I will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah, but I will strike with blindness all the horses of the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts: ‘The people of Jerusalem are my strength, for the LORD of Hosts is their God.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves; they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left, while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So on that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The land will mourn, each clan on its own: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and all the remaining clans and their wives.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will say to him, ‘You shall not remain alive, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD.’ When he prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will pierce him through.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I work the land, for I was purchased as a servant in my youth.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If someone asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your chest?’ he will answer, ‘These are the wounds I received in the house of my friends.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion, declares the LORD of Hosts. Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And in all the land, declares the LORD, two-thirds will be cut off and perish, but a third will be left in it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’
name: The LORD
